### Day 77: 2 Samuel 24:11–17
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-77-2-samuel-24-1117.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 24:11-17
Points:
- The severe judgment reflected Israel's own disobedience under the covenant, not only David's personal failure.
- David sinned by relying on human strength and numbers rather than trusting God to fight his battles.
- Unlike Moses, David initially failed to stand in the gap and intercede for the sins of the nation.
- The census was driven by pride and distrust despite God's proven faithfulness over the king's life.
- Seeing the angel strike down the people finally led David to take personal responsibility and plead for the sheep.
